tools.name: find-integration
tools.description: Look up a CircleCI integration or orb by name.

query.description: Integration or orb name to search for, e.g. 'aws' or 'slack'.

tools.name: get-api-reference
tools.description: Get a link to the CircleCI API v2 reference for a given endpoint area, such as pipelines, insights, or OIDC tokens. Only known endpoint areas deep-link to their section; anything else lands at the top of the reference.

endpointArea.description: Endpoint area to jump to, e.g. 'insights' or 'pipeline'. Omit for the full API reference.

tools.name: get-pricing
tools.description: Get CircleCI pricing plans and cost information.

tools.name: get-product-info
tools.description: Get information about a CircleCI product or feature, such as orbs, insights, or self-hosted runners. Only known feature areas resolve to a specific page; anything else lands on the general product overview.

feature.description: Feature or product area, e.g. 'orbs', 'insights', or 'self-hosted-runners'. Omit for the general product overview.

tools.name: search-docs
tools.description: Search CircleCI documentation for a topic, feature, or error message.

query.description: Search term, e.g. 'docker layer caching' or 'workflow syntax'.
